serving.text_only_input_quote: note = 'Patient 45yo male, fever and dry cough for 3 days. Temp 38.5C, HR 98, BP 120/80.'
serving.notes: config.json max_position_embeddings is 8192. The card's training max sequence length is 512. generation_config.json sets only bos, eos, and pad token ids. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja. If the first message is not a system message, that template inserts 'You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face'. The card's example sets the system message to Extract:. The repository has model.safetensors and no adapter_config.json.

evaluation_reported.text: On the oopere/clinical-ner-qdora test set (40 samples, 5 categories), this QLoRA model with the minimal Extract: prompt has 95.0% schema compliance. The same card reports the SmolLM2-1.7B baseline at 87.5% with a 15-line prompt and 0.0% with Extract:. The dataset card instead reports 100.0% schema compliance for QLoRA with Extract:.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is qlora only. The card names notebook CH07_NB02_L4_QLoRA_QDoRA, and that notebook trains the QLoRA run with SFTTrainer. Dataset id and parent match. The card says 200 train samples; the dataset card says 400 rows with a 90/10 split, and the notebook maps the full train split. The card reports 95.0% schema compliance; the dataset card reports 100.0% for QLoRA.
